Development release of Typstographe, a semantic document editor powered by Typst.

Installers are provided for macOS (Intel and Apple Silicon), Linux x86_64
(`.deb` and AppImage), and Windows x64. They include the application, Typst
engine, bundled models and fonts; Rust and Node.js are not required to use them.

These development installers are not signed or notarized. Application signing,
automatic updates and package-manager distribution are planned separately.

`SHA256SUMS` and the installer manifest identify the files and source commit.
Review these notes and the installers before publishing this draft.
